diff --git a/mail/components/compose/content/MsgComposeCommands.js b/mail/components/compose/content/MsgComposeCommands.js

--- a/mail/components/compose/content/MsgComposeCommands.js
+++ b/mail/components/compose/content/MsgComposeCommands.js
@@ -2718,9 +2718,7 @@ async function UpdateAttachment(attachmentItem, updateSettings = {}) {
           attachmentItem.attachment.cloudFileAccountKey =
             destCloudFileAccount.accountKey;
 
-          Services.telemetry.keyedScalarAdd(
-            "tb.filelink.uploaded_size",
-            destCloudFileAccount.type,
+          Glean.tb.filelinkUploadedSize[destCloudFileAccount.type].add(
             file.fileSize
           );
         }
diff --git a/mail/components/telemetry/Scalars.yaml b/mail/components/telemetry/Scalars.yaml
index 2c799062786..a131c7c6252 100644
--- a/mail/components/telemetry/Scalars.yaml
+++ b/mail/components/telemetry/Scalars.yaml
@@ -99,22 +99,6 @@ tb.account:
     record_in_processes:
       - 'main'
 
-tb.filelink:
-  uploaded_size:
-    bug_numbers:
-      - 1615984
-    description: Accumulated file size (bytes) uploaded to filelink services, keyed by filelink provider type.
-    release_channel_collection: opt-out
-    expires: never
-    products:
-      - 'thunderbird'
-    keyed: true
-    kind: uint
-    notification_emails:
-      - "telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net"
-    record_in_processes:
-      - 'main'
-
 tb.mails:
   sent:
     bug_numbers:
diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index bdbc26bd6f5..44094a9fb26 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -153,6 +153,22 @@ tb:
           "toolbox"
         type: string
 
+  filelink_uploaded_size:
+    type: labeled_counter
+    description: >
+      Accumulated file size (bytes) uploaded to FileLink services, keyed by
+      FileLink provider type.
+    bugs:
+      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1615984
+      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1899602
+    data_reviews:
+      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1903006
+    data_sensitivity:
+      - technical
+    notification_emails:
+      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
+    expires: never
+
   filelink_ignored:
     type: counter
     description: How many times suggestion to use FileLink were ignored.
diff --git a/mail/test/browser/cloudfile/browser_filelinkTelemetry.js b/mail/test/browser/cloudfile/browser_filelinkTelemetry.js
index 3bec7fc6e06..a2c98f139d0 100644
--- a/mail/test/browser/cloudfile/browser_filelinkTelemetry.js
+++ b/mail/test/browser/cloudfile/browser_filelinkTelemetry.js
@@ -56,7 +56,7 @@ const kBoxId = "compose-notification-bottom";
  * Check that we're counting file size uploaded.
  */
 add_task(async function test_filelink_uploaded_size() {
-  Services.telemetry.clearScalars();
+  Services.fog.testResetFOG();
   const testFile1Size = 495;
   const testFile2Size = 637;
   const totalSize = testFile1Size + testFile2Size;
@@ -73,12 +73,9 @@ add_task(async function test_filelink_uploaded_size() {
   gMockCloudfileManager.resolveUploads();
   await wait_for_notification_to_stop(cwc, kBoxId, "bigAttachmentUploading");
 
-  const scalars = TelemetryTestUtils.getProcessScalars("parent", true);
-  Assert.equal(
-    scalars["tb.filelink.uploaded_size"][provider.displayName],
-    totalSize,
-    "Count of uploaded size must be correct."
-  );
+  const value =
+    Glean.tb.filelinkUploadedSize[provider.displayName].testGetValue();
+  Assert.equal(value, totalSize, "Count of uploaded size must be correct.");
   await close_compose_window(cwc);
 });
 
@@ -104,9 +101,6 @@ add_task(async function test_filelink_ignored() {
   // Send Later to avoid uncatchable errors from the SMTP code.
   cwc.goDoCommand("cmd_sendLater");
   await aftersend;
-  Assert.equal(
-    Glean.tb.filelinkIgnored.testGetValue(),
-    1,
-    "Count of ignored times must be correct."
-  );
+  const count = Glean.tb.filelinkIgnored.testGetValue();
+  Assert.equal(count, 1, "Count of ignored times must be correct.");
 });
